## Contributor Checklist

- [ ] Requirement identifiers have been verified against the requirements specification.
- [ ] All affected system functional requirements have been identified.
- [ ] At least one new or modified AUnit test is supplied for each affected requirement, unless an exception is justified.
- [ ] New or modified tests are registered in the AUnit test suite.
- [ ] Requirements documentation changes have been identified, if necessary.

## Reviewer Checklist

- [ ] The referenced requirements are relevant and complete.
- [ ] The implementation satisfies the referenced requirements.
- [ ] The test cases adequately verify the changes.
- [ ] CI results and applicable verification evidence have been reviewed.
- [ ] Any exceptions are justified and acceptable.
